title: Installation Jobs Tariff Note: Failed-Access Fee Amount
content:
**Tariff note — amount of the failed-access fee on Installation Jobs**

The failed-access fee billed on an **Installation Jobs** record for a failed-access visit is the failed-access fee of the job's installation method, shown in the product's crew arrival and access terms by method. It is charged once for the visit and dated the day of the visit.

Every multiplier acting on the fee acts together on the one figure, and the fee is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Elements of the charge

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Amount | the method's failed-access fee |
| Frequency | once for the visit |
| Date | the day of the visit |
| Rounding | to the nearest cent, once, at the end |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A failed-access visit happens on a Tuesday on a job whose method carries a hypothetical failed-access fee figure of 210.00. The fee is 210.00, charged once and dated that Tuesday.

## Points of the note

- **One visit, one fee.** Each failed-access visit is charged once.
- **Which date.** The day of the visit fixes the date of the fee, whatever day the charge is booked.
- **Which method.** The figure is the one for the installation method named on the job.
